learning_outcomes.text: The aim of the exam is to provide the student with the opportunity to demonstrate at least a satisfactory command of the Finnish language, as required by Aalto University's degree regulations, which is necessary for state personnel in a bilingual authority and relevant to their own field (Law 424/2003, Decree 481/2003).

syllabus_topics: In the oral exam, the student presents a method, product, company, course, innovation, problem, etc. from their own field in a small group. The presentation is a convincing, informative speech of a few minutes without presentation technology or notes. In addition, the presentation is discussed. The purpose of the exam is to demonstrate knowledge of the basic vocabulary of one's own field.
assessment_rules: Grade scale: sis-toinen-kotim. This indicates pass/fail or satisfactory/unsatisfactory.
